# Mega Health Rx Pharmacy

> Mega Health Rx is an independent pharmacy at 64-51 108th Street, Forest Hills, Queens, NY 11375. It offers free prescription delivery anywhere in New York City, same-day prescription transfers from chain pharmacies, walk-in vaccinations, and pharmacist services in English and Russian. The owner and supervising pharmacist is Dr. Sam Borukhov, PharmD.

Key facts:

- Address: 64-51 108th Street, Forest Hills, NY 11375 (serves Forest Hills, Rego Park, Corona, Lefrak City, Elmhurst, Kew Gardens and all five NYC boroughs by delivery)
- Phone: (516) 304-5038 · Fax: (516) 268-9311 · Email: info@mymegahealth.com
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 9 am–7 pm, Friday 9 am–4 pm, Sunday 9 am–6 pm, closed Saturday
- Delivery: free anywhere in NYC, no minimum, no membership
- Insurance: most commercial plans (including CVS Caremark, Express Scripts and OptumRx), most Medicare Part D and Medicare Advantage plans, most New York Medicaid plans (NYRx), and the OTC Network benefit card
- Languages: English and Russian
- Walk-in vaccines: flu, COVID-19, shingles (Shingrix), pneumonia, RSV and Tdap

## Get started

- [Transfer a prescription](https://mymegahealth.com/get-started.html): Transfer prescriptions in about a minute; the pharmacy calls your old pharmacy and your doctor.
- [Refill a prescription](https://mymegahealth.com/refill.html): Request a refill online for delivery or pickup.
- [Questions and answers](https://mymegahealth.com/questions.html): Answers to 22 common questions about transfers, insurance, delivery, refills and vaccines.
- [For doctors](https://mymegahealth.com/for-doctors.html): How prescribers can send prescriptions to the pharmacy.
- [Meet the pharmacist](https://mymegahealth.com/meet-the-pharmacist.html): Dr. Sam Borukhov, PharmD, owner and supervising pharmacist; fluent in English and Russian.
